cases.name: heredoc
argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,tempfile
p=Path(tempfile.mkstemp()[1]);p.write_text('ok');assert p.read_text()=='ok'
print('HEREDOC_OK')
PY
